node.title: P1 and the strict E22 remainder collapse the full-petal tail to m+1
node.statement: If d>=ell(m-2) and 0<=r<ell, then ceil((ell+d-r)/ell)>=m-1. The exact full-petal touched-set tail is therefore at most C(m,m-1)+C(m,m)=m+1, and domain disjointness with an official core k>=2 gives m+1<=n. Thus K4 holds with b4=1.
